reason: A proposes a testable post-quench intervention that extends the reported melt-spinning result by attempting glass-state relaxation and measuring whether crystallization onset and phase fraction improve against an as-quenched baseline. B largely restates the already demonstrated finding that melt spinning at 10^5–10^6 K/s produces an amorphous alloy, while A’s proposed temperature window remains risky and must be established experimentally to avoid crystallization.
